old:
Build your own CLI from the core module root, and run it from a scratch
workspace with the provider environment configured as in Chapter 0. Discover
an available streaming-capable model; keep the key in the intended child's
environment without printing it or putting it in a command argument.

```sh
go build -o /tmp/ch6agent .
```
new:
Build your own CLI from the core module root, selecting its actual main
package. The example below uses `./cmd/ch01`; use `.` only if the CLI's main
package lives at the module root. Run it from a scratch workspace with the
provider environment configured as in Chapter 0. Discover an available
streaming-capable model; keep the key in the intended child's environment
without printing it or putting it in a command argument.

```sh
go build -o /tmp/ch6agent ./cmd/ch01
```
